공통.세트: Cinematic film still from a Korean psychological thriller, 16:9 frame. Location: a small Seoul apartment living room late at night with the main lights off — a deep wine-red velvet sofa, a string of tiny warm-yellow fairy-light bulbs draped along the wall behind the sofa, three lit pillar candles on a low dark-wood coffee table, and a floor lamp with a red fabric shade washing the room in deep red light. Hard red key light from the left, warm flickering candlelight from below, deep black shadows, a faint haze in the air, natural film grain, shot on a cinema camera. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
공통.세트_참조: Image {n} shows the room and its lighting: use it only for the background, set dressing and light — not for the composition or framing.
공통.유호_얼굴: HIS FACE: he is the exact same Korean man as in Images 1 and 2 — keep exactly that face in every detail, at his best: well-rested, freshly groomed, clear healthy skin, bright eyes. Images 3 to 5 are his real photos, for identity only (ignore the short hair in Image 3 and all backgrounds and clothing). Do not change his features, do not make him look older or younger, and do not add glasses.
공통.유호_옷: HAIR, BODY AND WARDROBE: his thin cornrows (about ten rows) are mostly hidden under the hood, only the front rows show at his hairline. He is 180 cm tall with size 110 (XXL) tops — naturally broad shoulders and a fuller chest, not a bodybuilder. He wears a plain black hooded jacket with the hood pulled up over his head, and black leather gloves. No mask, no balaclava — his whole face is visible. No weapon is visible anywhere in the frame.
공통.유호_장면참조: Image 6 shows him in this same scene: keep the same hooded jacket, gloves, room, light and camera look as Image 6, but take his face only from Images 1 to 5.
공통.사진남: Photorealistic film still, documentary-plate realism: natural skin texture with visible pores, realistic hair, natural proportions, not airbrushed. He is the only person in the frame. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
공통.통2_얼굴: Use the four attached photos (Images 1 to 4) only as identity references for one Korean woman about 30 years old. Keep her face and body exactly the same: her full round face with soft cheeks and a soft double chin, thick straight dark eyebrows, her short tightly curled dark-brown permed bob, her plus-size figure (163 cm, Korean clothing size 88), and — when her teeth show — only a very narrow gap between her two front teeth (both front teeth fully there). Ignore the backgrounds, clothing and lighting of the reference photos. Do not add moles, freckles, marks, tattoos, text, logos or watermarks.
공통.통2_옷: She wears a lavender fleece pajama top with tiny white polka dots.
공통.리4_얼굴: Use the four attached photos (Images 1 to 4) only as identity references for one Korean woman about 27 years old. Keep her face exactly the same: her round face, her black bowl-cut bob with straight blunt bangs just above the eyebrows, her large round tortoiseshell glasses with clean clear lenses, and the small mole on her cheek exactly where it is in the reference photos. Ignore the backgrounds, clothing and lighting of the reference photos. Do not add other moles, freckles, marks, tattoos, text, logos or watermarks.
공통.리4_옷: She wears a sage-green knit sweater over a white collared shirt.
공통.사진: Photorealistic film still, natural skin texture with visible pores, realistic individual hair strands, natural proportions. She is the only person in the frame.
공통.우는_연기: This is a horror-film parody, so the crying is big and dramatic — but she must stay unmistakably the same woman as in Images 1 to 4.
